changes: Draft notifications now carry the acknowledged snapshot revision or the exact removed attachment ID. Accepted cleanup reloads a mounted draft only when its current revision matches.

useDraft tracks unsaved current-instance state and protects it inside load itself, including input committed before the initial passive load. Generic refresh cannot erase unsaved fields or their save-failure warning. A successful save restores normal refresh behavior.
Same-key read failures preserve valid current memory; new-key and ABA loads remain isolated. No global draft cache or automatic request replay was introduced.

Confirmed attachment removal is broadcast even if an old unmounted instance cannot read/write storage. The active owner removes only that attachment from its current draft and attempts to save the merged fields, retaining a warning on failure.

Added 11 meaningful draft regression cases, including all fields with text ABA, three accepted-receipt cleanup paths, natural aggregate capacity failure, generic refresh, same-key read failure/new-key isolation, old-instance attachment merge, successful persistence recovery, and first DOM commit input.
